summary: The Kuma polling client must bound requests, aggregate streamed heartbeatList events, preserve mutation payload alignment, order incident timelines by timestamp, and redact monitor URL credentials.
reason: Kuma v2 delivers management data over long-polling Socket.IO, where incomplete stream collection and unbounded requests can produce false incident results or hung operators; monitor data is also remote input and must not leak credentials.
validated_outcome: Focused protocol, timeout, aggregation, ordering, and redaction regression tests pass.
